pairs: Observa mensem novarum frugum,
“Observe the month of new grain,
et verni primum temporis,
at the beginning of springtime,
ut facias Phase Domino Deo tuo:
so that you may accomplish the Passover to the Lord your God.
quoniam in isto mense eduxit te Dominus Deus tuus de Ægypto nocte.
For in this month, the Lord your God led you away from Egypt in the night.
Immolabisque Phase Domino Deo tuo de ovibus,
And you shall immolate the Passover to the Lord your God,
et de bobus,
from sheep and from oxen,
in loco quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus,
in the place which the Lord your God will choose,
ut habitet nomen ejus ibi.
so that his name may dwell there.
Non comedes in eo panem fermentatum:
You shall not eat it with leavened bread.
septem diebus comedes absque fermento afflictionis panem,
For seven days you shall eat, without leaven, the bread of affliction.
quoniam in pavore egressus es de Ægypto:
For you departed from Egypt in fear.
ut memineris diei egressionis tuæ de Ægypto,
So may you remember the day of your departure from Egypt,
omnibus diebus vitæ tuæ.
throughout all the days of your life.
Non apparebit fermentum in omnibus terminis tuis septem diebus,
No leaven shall be present in all your confines for seven days. And by morning,
et non remanebit de carnibus ejus, quod immolatum est vespere in die primo, usque mane.
there shall not remain any of the flesh which was immolated on the first day in the evening.
Non poteris immolare Phase in qualibet urbium tuarum,
You cannot immolate the Passover in any of your cities,
quas Dominus Deus tuus daturus est tibi,
which the Lord your God will give to you, that you wish,
sed in loco quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus,
but only in the place which the Lord your God will choose,
ut habitet nomen ejus ibi:
so that his name may dwell there.
immolabis Phase vespere ad solis occasum,
You shall immolate the Passover in the evening, upon the setting of the sun,
quando egressus es de Ægypto.
which is the time when you departed from Egypt.
Et coques, et comedes in loco quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus,
And you shall cook and eat it in the place which the Lord your God will choose,
maneque consurgens vades in tabernacula tua.
and, rising up in the morning, you shall go into your tent.
Sex diebus comedes azyma:
For six days, you shall eat unleavened bread.
et in die septima,
And on the seventh day,
quia collecta est Domini Dei tui,
because it is the assembly of the Lord your God,
non facies opus.
you shall do no work.
Septem hebdomadas numerabis tibi ab ea die qua falcem in segetem miseris.
You shall number for yourself seven weeks from that day, the day on which you put the sickle to the grain field.
Et celebrabis diem festum hebdomadarum Domino Deo tuo,
And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks, to the Lord your God,
oblationem spontaneam manus tuæ,
with a voluntary oblation from your hand,
quam offeres juxta benedictionem Domini Dei tui:
which you shall offer according to the blessing of the Lord your God.
et epulaberis coram Domino Deo tuo,
And you shall feast in the sight of the Lord your God:
tu,
you,
filius tuus et filia tua,
your son and your daughter,
servus tuus et ancilla tua,
your man servant and your woman servant,
et Levites qui est intra portas tuas,
and the Levite who is within your gates,
advena ac pupillus et vidua,
and the new arrival as well as the orphan and the widow,
qui morantur vobiscum:
who abide with you,
in loco quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus,
in the place which the Lord your God will choose,
ut habitet nomen ejus ibi.
so that his name may dwell there.
Et recordaberis quoniam servus fueris in Ægypto:
And you shall recall that you were a servant in Egypt.
custodiesque ac facies quæ præcepta sunt.
And you shall preserve and carry out the things that have been instructed.
Solemnitatem quoque tabernaculorum celebrabis per septem dies,
Likewise,
quando collegeris de area
you shall celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days,
et torculari fruges tuas:
when you will have gathered your fruits from the orchard and the winepress.
et epulaberis in festivitate tua,
And you shall feast at the time of your festival:
tu,
you,
filius tuus et filia,
your son and daughter,
servus tuus et ancilla,
your man servant and woman servant,
Levites quoque et advena,
likewise the Levite and the new arrival,
pupillus et vidua qui intra portas tuas sunt.
the orphan and the widow, who are within your gates.
Septem diebus Domino Deo tuo festa celebrabis in loco quem elegerit Dominus:
For seven days you shall celebrate feasts to the Lord your God in the place which the Lord will choose.
benedicetque tibi Dominus Deus tuus in cunctis frugibus tuis,
And the Lord your God will bless you in all your crops,
et in omni opere manuum tuarum,
and in every work of your hands.
erisque in lætitia.
And you shall be joyful.
Tribus vicibus per annum apparebit omne masculinum tuum in conspectu Domini Dei tui in loco quem elegerit:
Three times a year, all your males shall appear in the sight the Lord your God in the place which he will choose:
in solemnitate azymorum, in solemnitate hebdomadarum,
at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks,
et in solemnitate tabernaculorum.
and at the Feast of Tabernacles.
Non apparebit ante Dominum vacuus:
No one shall appear before the Lord empty.
sed offeret unusquisque secundum quod habuerit juxta benedictionem Domini Dei sui,
But each one shall offer according to what he will have, according to the blessing of the Lord his God,
quam dederit ei.
which he will give to him.
Judices et magistros constitues in omnibus portis tuis,
You shall appoint judges and magistrates at all your gates,
quas Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi,
which the Lord your God will give to you,
per singulas tribus tuas:
throughout each of your tribes,
ut judicent populum justo judicio,
so that they may judge the people with a just judgment,
nec in alteram partem declinent.
and not so as to show favoritism to either side.
Non accipies personam,
You shall not accept a person’s reputation,
nec munera:
nor gifts.
quia munera excæcant oculos sapientum,
For gifts blind the eyes of the wise
et mutant verba justorum.
and alter the words of the just.
Juste quod justum est persequeris:
You shall justly pursue what is just,
ut vivas,
so that you may live
et possideas terram,
and possess the land,
quam Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi.
which the Lord your God will give to you.
Non plantabis lucum,
You shall not plant a sacred grove,
et omnem arborem juxta altare Domini Dei tui.
nor shall you plant any tree near the altar of the Lord your God;
Nec facies tibi,
you shall neither make
neque constitues statuam:
nor set up for yourself a statue.
quæ odit Dominus Deus tuus.
These things the Lord your God hates.”
